title: H1.23 exploratory task-family heterogeneity audit
objective: After H1.18-H1.21 negative recovery, carrier, horizon, and action-admissibility diagnostics and H1.22 task-level clustering, test whether frozen BASE-30 capability differs descriptively between held-out mens_fashion and womens_fashion task families.
scientific_question: Under the frozen base agent and interface, do held-out simple fashion tasks show family-level heterogeneity in closed-loop behavior?
hypothesis: The mens_fashion family may differ descriptively from womens_fashion; this is an exploratory heterogeneity hypothesis, not a claim about learning or OpenEvo efficacy.
claim_boundary: This group is BASE-30 only, has no training, memory, adapter, teacher, retrieval, or outcome-conditioned selection, and cannot open Q3, H2, D0, retention, transfer, or SEED.
stop_rules: Do not retry valid completions or change task identities, seeds, prompt, parser, horizon, denominator, or family definitions after launch.
Report family differences as exploratory descriptive heterogeneity only; if both families are zero or invalid, release GPUs and do not start another micro-variant.
